mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, voucher_id, order_date, [status], total_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, shipping_fullname, shipping_phone, shipping_address, shipping_city, note, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{voucherId}, GETDATE(), 'pending', #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{shippingFullname}, #{shippingPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, #{shippingCity}, #{note}, GETDATE())
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM orders
AND [status] = #{status}
AND (shipping_fullname LIKE '%' + #{searchTerm} + '%' OR shipping_phone LIKE '%' + #{searchTerm} + '%' OR CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR) = #{searchTerm})
ORDER BY order_date DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) p.product_id, p.title as product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.variant_id = p.product_id -- Lưu ý khớp variant_id/product_id WHERE o.[status] IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.title ORDER BY total_sold DESC
